notes:
USAGE:
A formal term for written documents, especially those with official or institutional significance. More formal than ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧ (documents, paperwork) and ⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧ (writing, text, prose). Note the difference in reading: {文書|ぶんしょ} vs. ⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧{文書|ぶんしょ}: official document
- ⟦{機密|きみつ}→機密：13179_kimitsu⟧{文書|ぶんしょ}: classified document
- {文書|ぶんしょ}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: document management
- {文書|ぶんしょ}⟦{偽造|ぎぞう}→偽造：11524_gizou⟧: document forgery
- ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧{文書|ぶんしょ}: historical document

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧: documents, paperwork (everyday business use)
- ⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧: writing, text, prose (focus on the written content)
- ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧: materials, documents (for reference or research)
